{{Quote|We had trekked about 2500 meters to the northeast of Dearic when the storm hits. Luckily Trenrel found a cave, so we've taken shelter inside. The cave's eerily silent at the entrance and for some reason we're hesitant to venture much further into the darkness.|A travel journal entry|<ref name="10HSTG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref>}}
The '''Giant Fynock Cave''' was a cave northeast of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was populated by giant [[fynock]]s.<ref name="SWG:GFC" />

==History==
{{Quote|The attack was sudden and without warning. Several scuttling creatures overran our camp while large flying creatures dove at us from above. As we tried to gather ourselves, I saw Mitsh and Trenrel fall, unmoving and instantly covered by a swarming mound of chittering, insect-like creatures.|A travel journal entry|<ref name="10HSTG" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="10HSTG" /> a small scientific expedition,<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|32|Heitop}}</ref> including [[Mitsh]], [[Trenrel]], [[Yill'uop]], [[Heitop]] and [[Frann]], sought shelter from a storm inside this cave. They were attacked by the fynocks and all but one died in the attack. The last survivor started burying his dead friends. In the last entry in the journal, the survivor wrote down his plans to return into the cave the next day to recover the remaining bodies.<ref name="10HSTG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Giant Fynock Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GFC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Giant Fynock Cave was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]," released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref> In the strategy guides for ''Star Wars Galaxies'' that list this location as a point of interest on Talus, its name is misspelled as "Giant Flynock Cave".<ref name="SWG:TCG:POGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
